ModelAppearance.luau.description: Allows the appearance of a model to be overridden. Most commonly used when placing down an object in a building game. Public entry points include `ModelAppearance.new`, `ModelAppearance.DisableInteractions`, `ModelAppearance.SetCanCollide`, `ModelAppearance.ResetCanCollide`, `ModelAppearance.SetTransparency`, `ModelAppearance.ResetTransparency`, `ModelAppearance.SetColor`, `ModelAppearance.ResetColor`.
